d: Traveling to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young; witnessing giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands' massive coral reef; a glimpse into the evolutionary past.

Scan the Australian skies which regularly delivers a volatile weather; await cooling monsoon rains; watch lightning ignite vast wildfires; witness the adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.
A male brown hare throws punches at his beloved; admiring a sandhill crane dance battle; ibexes butt heads (literally) during mating season; why leopards are stealth masters.

Meeting alphas who get by with a little help from their friends; the inescapable gang mentality of mating male dolphins; ant colonies' unique scents; female geladas always get the last word; wolves hunt family-style.

Experiencing a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuary's orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild; Dilla's fate suddenly changes, and big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

A cat named Lovebug requires emergency surgery after being shot in the leg; a Pomeranian named Cheeka has a bad cough; Savannah and Dayle take a trip to learn some horse-handling skills from a well-known Métis expert.

Brooke demonstrates the ever-important job of vet techs as she helps a dog named Charlie who was injured in a dogfight; Dr. Savannah treats a dog who was kicked by a horse; Brooke and Savannah then head over to a spay and neuter clinic in Sturgeon Lake.
A mysterious predator prowls the streets of a giant metropolis.
See the team tutor a baby mink and provide a coyote some alone time to heal.
Observe turtle eye surgery and see a raccoon get out of a very sticky situation.

Dr. Cori puts on a smile for her least favorite job, cow pregnancy testing; Dr. Allison treats an orange cat with a skin condition and uses a musical trick to calm the nerves of a soon-to-be neutered dog.

Dr. Emma sets off on a road trip to Siksika Nation to help stray dogs get healthy and find their forever homes; in Saskatoon, Dr. Allison examines a worrying lump on an older dog with a big personality.
Navigate rain, new climbing structures, and a first meeting of the summer cubs.
Watch as a goose gets physio and the team uncovers a case of mistaken identity.

Follow an injured opossum into surgery, as the medical team realizes amputation may be the only way to save his badly injured toe; meet some turtle hatchlings who seem ready for release when the team gets disappointing details about their size.
A mysterious predator prowls the streets of a giant metropolis.
A farm dog named Wrangler was run over by a tractor; a foal named Missy ripped her eyelid on a barbed wire fence; Savannah heads to the Enoch Cree Nation to run an emergency Parvo clinic.

Dr. Dayle treats an adorable mini pony named Daisy who's got a strange growth on her face and helps a mama cow during a difficult calving; Savannah must work to diagnose a dog named Bernadette who has stopped eating due to chronic pain.
Gasp at the awe-inspiring strength of crocodiles and fight dirty with guanacos.
Unleash bullet-fast blows with mantis shrimp and face g-forces with a gannet.
Experience a pigeon's internal GPS and a dolphin's prey-sensitive seventh sense.
Strike foes with venomous jellyfish and see birds crush poisonous attacks.
Exploit turtle chaos with tiger sharks and withstand pressure with ghost sharks.
Stalk prey, wait for the perfect strike and go on epic migrations with sharks.
Epic snake rescues: browns, pythons and a wild mating ball in Queensland!
The snakes are mating, invading a lounge and infiltrating a chicken coop.
The story of two mothers, a crocodile and a hippopotamus, as they face the perils of raising a family in this beautiful, remote location of Katuma.
Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition; uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas; catch an epic giraffe battle.

Gangs battle for dominance, their lives a constant struggle; locusts swarm, stripping landscapes bare; the coconut octopus ambushes prey, a master of deception; nature reveals its raw power, where only the strongest survive.

Dr. Allison's clinic is full of nerves and worry as she and her staff bring in their own animals for vet care; Dr. Emma picks up some tips for working with small companion animals from Calgary's top exotic vet specialist.

Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild; get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

A dental surgery goes from one tooth to nine teeth for a pair of unsuspecting dog owners; Savannah must investigate to figure out why a ferret named Sophie has stopped peeing, and a bunny needs intervention to stop him from biting at his sutures.

Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub; See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex; check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur; cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll; hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years; later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.
Featuring a birthday celebration for a donkey, a game with a skunk, and an introduction to a beaver; it also examines the care routines for a tree kangaroo.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed; learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers; Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.
Deadly snakes lurk as elite wranglers race to stop danger before it strikes.
Wranglers face venom, tangled traps and fierce reptiles in high-stakes rescues.

Navigate the forest with a cub, watch young adults claim their territory and witness the exile of aging hunters; discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

Battle harsh environments and challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young; cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cat's fate for better or worse.

d: Taking a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and exploring a true paradise for ocean creatures: glimpsing a stealthy manta ray, enjoying dolphin antics and admiring a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.
The Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand; a pod of bottlenose dolphins, short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.
